d: The theater represents the entrance of a farm. Countryside at the bottom where a stream flows, on the shore of which some Lavandaie prepare the laundry. In the middle a large tree, under which Giannetta, the Reapers and the Reapers rest. Adina sits aside reading. Nemorino observes it from afar.
Drum sound: everyone gets up. Belcore arrives driving a soldier's drapple, which remain lined up in the bottom. He approaches Adina, greets her and presents a bribe.
Piazza in the village. Osteria della Pernice on one side. Paesani, who go and are occupied in various chores. Odesi a trumpet sound: women come out of the houses with curiosity: men come, etc., etc.
Doctor Dulcamara standing on a golden chariot, standing, holding cards and bottles in his hand. Behind it a Servant who plays the trumpet. All the villagers surround him.
Belcore inside, go into the stage and say.
He plays the drum: Giannetta comes out with the Contadine, and the Soldiers of Belcore come along.

Interior of the farm of Adina. On one side table set to which are seated Adina, Belcore, Dulcamara, and Giannetta. The village dwellers standing drinking and singing. Against the players of the regiment mounted on a kind of orchestra sonando the trumpets.
Rustic courtyard open in the background. Giannetta and Paesane.
Adina and Dulcamara come in from various parts, they stop in amazement to see Nemorino courted by the Villanelle; and sayings.
Belcore with Soldiers and sayings; then Dulcamara with the whole village.
